clue.text: Cut strip out of cape as sample

indicators.note: read as 'outside of': the cut strip sits outside the abbreviation for cape

parts.note: a swath is a strip of grass or corn cut by a scythe
C is the map abbreviation for cape

explanation.surface: A tailor snips a strip off a cloak to show a customer the material.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of' is read as 'outside': SWATH goes round C.
explanation.definitionFit: A small piece of fabric shown as an example of the material is called by this name.

clue.text: Surrealist leader on the booze is producing dotty pictures

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: tippling is drinking habitually

explanation.surface: A drunken surrealist painter churns out crazy paintings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dotty' looks like crazy; it means made of dots.
explanation.definitionFit: Painting with many small dots is the technique this word names.

clue.text: He doesn't believe that he is taking part

indicators.note: the answer is a part of the run of words that he is taking

explanation.surface: A man who refuses to believe he is joining in.
explanation.definitionFit: A nonbeliever in any god is the person meant.

clue.text: Fellow countryman pulled out of the Potomac river —- it's turbulent

indicators.note: turbulent water is churned, so the letters are churned up

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A fellow American is dragged out of the rough waters of the Potomac.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from the same country as you is a compatriot, a countryman.

clue.text: Consolation by word of mouth from the castle

parts.note: balm is something soothing, a consolation
oral means spoken rather than written

explanation.surface: Comforting words passed along by speech from the royal residence.
explanation.walkthrough: BALMORAL is the royal family's castle in Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: The Scottish royal residence on Deeside is the famous example of a castle meant here.

clue.text: A foolish sheep upset the shepherdess

indicators.note: in a down clue upset turns the words upside down, so they are read backwards

parts.note: silly means foolish
a ram is a male sheep

explanation.surface: A daft sheep knocks over a girl tending the flock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' reverses SILLY RAM together to give MARYLLIS. Amaryllis is a stock shepherdess in pastoral poetry, from Virgil.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a conventional name for a country girl in classical pastoral verse.

clue.text: Might sound a very small amount

indicators.note: sound says the word is heard, not written

parts.note: the word might, meaning strength

explanation.surface: A tiny quantity could perhaps make a noise.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny bit is a mite, as in the widow's mite.

clue.text: Operated on the sovereign by order

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed on top of the other

parts.note: ran means operated, as of a machine
a king is a sovereign

explanation.surface: Surgeons operated on the monarch under instruction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Operated on' looks like surgery; 'on' just stacks RAN above KING.
explanation.definitionFit: Placing in a graded position means arranging in order, as a rank does.

clue.text: Reluctant student has promise

parts.note: L is a learner, as on a learner driver's plate
an oath is a solemn promise

explanation.surface: An unwilling student gives their word.
explanation.definitionFit: Unwilling or disinclined is this word's sense.

clue.text: One may be capped, being madly keen

indicators.note: acting madly scrambles the letters

explanation.surface: A keen player may be capped for their country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capped' suggests sport; it is the kneecap.
explanation.definitionFit: The joint carries a bony cap, the patella, so it is something capped.

clue.text: At home, being frightfully cold

parts.note: to be in is to be at home
a human being, so a human

explanation.surface: Someone staying at home turns terribly chilly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being' looks like a verb but is the noun, a human being.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking compassion to a dreadful degree is a meaning of the word, so it fits utterly unfeeling.

clue.text: Round the mountain girl retracts aerial

indicators.note: turning round makes the mountain's name run backwards

parts.note: Etna is the Sicilian volcano, a stock crossword mountain

indicators.note: drawing back makes the girl's name run backwards

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl backs away from a mountain, round which something airborne flies.
explanation.walkthrough: Each word gets its own reversal signal: 'Round' for the mountain and 'retracts' for the girl, so the pieces join as two backward runs.
explanation.definitionFit: A radio receiving rod is called an aerial in Britain and by this other name too.

clue.text: Detective magazine

explanation.definitionFit: A private investigator is known by this phrase, which is also the title of a famous British satirical magazine.

clue.text: Horse and trap turned over not far away

indicators.note: the horse and trap are flipped, so both words run backwards

parts.note: H is slang for heroin, which is also called horse
a gin is a snare or trap

explanation.surface: A horse and its carriage overturn close by.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Horse' is heroin, H; 'trap' is a snare, GIN; 'turned over' reverses H+GIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Close at hand is the old-fashioned sense of this word.

clue.text: His business is looking up — he deals in futures

definitions.text: His business is looking up — he deals in futures

parts.words: His business is looking up — he deals in futures
parts.note: sounds like a thriving trader in commodity futures, but means someone who looks up at stars to foretell what is coming

explanation.definitionFit: A stargazing fortune-teller predicts coming events from the heavens.

clue.text: Jaundiced boy with a tic, perhaps

indicators.note: the boy's name goes alongside the rearranged letters
the tic may be rearranged, as 'perhaps' suggests the letters are one possibility

parts.note: Eric is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A sour-tempered lad who has a nervous twitch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jaundiced' wants to mean bitter; here it is the medical sense, yellowed by liver disease.
explanation.definitionFit: This medical adjective describes someone with jaundice, the yellowing of skin.

clue.text: The chatelain is able to admit Esther Johnson

indicators.note: to let in means the second piece goes inside the first

parts.note: can means is able
Jonathan Swift called his friend Esther Johnson Stella

explanation.surface: The lady of the castle can let in a visiting woman.
explanation.walkthrough: Esther Johnson was Swift's 'Stella' of the Journal to Stella.
explanation.definitionFit: A keeper or governor of a castle is called a castellan, matching the French chatelain.

clue.text: Dish in sink is in the way

indicators.note: the word for sink is placed inside the word for the way

parts.note: a lane is a way or road
to sag is to sink

explanation.surface: Plates left soaking in the sink get in everyone's way.
explanation.definitionFit: This Italian pasta bake is an example of a dish.

clue.text: Building let nearly always

indicators.note: building constructs something new from these letters

explanation.surface: A building is let nearly all the time.
explanation.definitionFit: Forever, without end, is the sense of this adverb.

clue.text: Apes a cobbler put back on the Rock

indicators.note: the reversed word follows the Rock's name

parts.note: Gib is short for Gibraltar, known as the Rock

indicators.note: putting back means the cobbler's word is written backwards

parts.note: snob is an old word for a shoemaker or cobbler

explanation.surface: A shoemaker mimics others after being sent back to Gibraltar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Apes' looks like a verb (mimics); it is the noun. Gibraltar's apes make the surface apt.
explanation.definitionFit: These long-armed primates are a kind of ape.

clue.text: Female howler has been getting unruly

indicators.note: becoming disorderly signals that the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A has-been woman getting out of control and shrieking.
explanation.walkthrough: The banshee is the Irish wailing spirit woman.
explanation.definitionFit: This Irish spirit is a woman whose wail foretells death.

clue.text: The best seaside boarder to emerge?

definitions.meaning: an ace on a surfboard, a champion surfer read as two words
to come up to the top, as from under water

explanation.definitionFit: To rise up through water is to come to the top; split, the word reads as a top surfer.

clue.text: Tall stories about university's Latin scholar

indicators.note: the tall stories go around the university letter

parts.note: attics are the top storeys of a tall house
U is the abbreviation for university

explanation.surface: Exaggerated yarns are told about a university classicist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tall stories' wants to be lies; here they are high floors. Atticus was Cicero's learned friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Titus Pomponius Atticus was a Roman man of letters, a scholar writing in Latin.

clue.text: Telephoned and spoke

definitions.meaning: called on the phone, past tense
a noun here: a crosspiece of a ladder or chair

explanation.definitionFit: It is the past participle of ring, calling on the phone, and also a ladder's crosspiece, like a spoke.

clue.text: Money — a factor in love!

definitions.meaning: the animal's horn is reputed to be an aphrodisiac

explanation.definitionFit: It is dated slang for cash, and the beast's powdered horn is fabled as an aphrodisiac.

clue.text: Italian ice-cream vendor?

definitions.meaning: a seller of the three-striped Naples-style ice cream, whimsically

explanation.definitionFit: A person from Naples is called this, and the striped ice cream bears the same name, so a vendor of it whimsically too.

clue.text: Pepper the skin

explanation.definitionFit: To pepper is to bombard with missiles, and an animal's hide is also so called.

clue.text: Vessels break up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to snap is to break

explanation.surface: Containers smash into pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Cooking pots are kinds of vessel.

clue.text: He told the story of his lame paranoiac

indicators.note: a paranoiac's mind is disordered, so the letters are disordered too

explanation.surface: A man describes his disabled, suspicious companion.
explanation.walkthrough: The narrator of Melville's Moby-Dick opens 'Call me Ishmael'.
explanation.definitionFit: Melville's sailor narrates the whaling novel, so he is the storyteller.

clue.text: It's clear that one in the middle of a trunk call has not finished

indicators.note: the word for one goes inside the run of the other pieces

parts.note: a log is a tree trunk

indicators.note: the word for call loses its final letter

parts.note: taken as written before trimming
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone notes it is obvious when a long-distance phone call is cut short.
explanation.walkthrough: A trunk call is old British for long-distance; here 'trunk' gives LOG and CALL loses L.
explanation.definitionFit: Reasoned and coherent thinking is clear in the sense of following plainly.

clue.text: Honour new saint by showing respect

parts.note: the OBE is a British honour, Officer of the Order of the British Empire

indicators.note: a new form of the word saint is a rearrangement

explanation.surface: A newly canonised saint is honoured with deference.
explanation.definitionFit: Being deferential or bowing in homage is this word's sense.

clue.text: One of the metal woods, presumably

definitions.text: One of the metal woods, presumably

parts.words: One of the metal woods, presumably
parts.note: a golf wood with a metal sole plate, whose name also suggests a metallic look

explanation.definitionFit: A brassie is an old golf club with a brass plate, and this spelling also means like brass.
